You look around and notice many other Gardevoir, Gallade, Kirlia and Ralts. And approaching you is the most largest Gardevoir you've seen, and this one looks different. Firstly, their body is more mature, one fitting a mature human woman with buxom curves, large breasts and a sizable rear. Secondly, her coloring is different too, consisting of blue, white, red and black instead of the normal coloration of a normal Gardevoir being green, white and pink.*
